mapper.select: SELECT tl.ledger_seq , tl.ledger_nm , tl.ledger_year , tul.user_seq , ( SELECT user_nm FROM tb_user WHERE user_seq = tul.user_seq ) AS user_nm , tul.master_yn , tul.auth_exit_date , tul.invite_agree_yn , tul.ledger_auth , tul.use_yn , tul.show_oneday_yn , tl.create_date FROM tb_ledger tl INNER JOIN tb_user_ledger tul ON tl.ledger_seq = tul.ledger_seq WHERE tl.del_yn = 'N' AND tul.ledger_seq in ( SELECT ledger_seq FROM tb_user_ledger WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} )
